blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Prior audio-visual self-supervised learning methods rely on mechanisms
such as EMA target encoders, prediction heads, reconstruction decoders, and
contrastive losses. We introduce LeAVJEPA, the first audio-visual encoder trained
under LeJEPA’s collapse-free objective. A single early-fusion Vision
Transformer processes audio, video, and joint audio-video inputs. Modality
dropout treats a missing modality as another view of the same event, making
cross-modal alignment implicit in the objective. The model aligns global
embeddings with modality-specific local embeddings, and SIGReg prevents
representational collapse. A controlled ablation identifies modality dropout
as the key mechanism for audio-visual alignment. Despite the architectural
simplicity, LeAVJEPA reaches 36.0 mAP on AudioSet-20K and 91.3%
accuracy on ESC-50 under frozen evaluation. After fine-tuning, it reaches 61.1% accuracy on VGGSound,
and its embeddings support zero-shot audio-visual retrieval.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Self-supervised learning (SSL) has become the dominant paradigm for learning representations from unlabelled data in vision ( He et al., 2022 ; Oquab et al., 2024 ) , audio ( Huang et al., 2022 ) , and video ( Bardes et al., 2024 ) . Video is a natural source of paired multimodal data: every clip pairs a visual stream with an audio stream that records the same event, and their co-occurrence provides supervision at no annotation cost ( Arandjelović & Zisserman, 2017 ; Korbar et al., 2018 ) . The pairing is also imperfect, since sound sources move off-screen and visible objects are often silent. A good audio-visual representation should therefore draw on both modalities, yet remain useful when either one is missing or uninformative.
blocks.zh: 自我监督的学习(SSL)已经成为从未加标签的视觉数据(He等人,2022年;Oquab等人,2024年),音频(Huang等人,2022年)和视频(Bardes等人,2024年)中学习表现的主导范例. 视频是配对多模式数据的自然来源:每个剪辑对一视觉流,并配有记录同一事件的音频流,其共同发生提供无注释成本的监督(Arandjelović & Zisserman,2017;Korbar等人,2018年). 配对也是不完善的,因为声音源从屏幕上移出,可见的物体经常是无声的. 因此,良好的视听表现方式应利用这两种方式,但在缺少这种方式或缺乏信息时仍然有用。

blocks.en:
Existing audio-visual SSL methods combine audio and video through several different training objectives. AV-MAE ( Georgescu et al., 2023 ) , CAV-MAE ( Gong et al., 2023 ) , MAViL ( Huang et al., 2023 ) , and CAV-MAE Sync ( Araujo et al., 2025 ) reconstruct masked spectrogram and pixel patches through decoders, most add InfoNCE terms over cross-modal negatives, and MAViL adds a second self-training stage. Alternatively, predicting in latent space focuses learning on representations and avoids reconstructing low-level input detail ( Assran et al., 2023 ; Bardes et al., 2024 ) . MJEPA ( Teotia et al., 2026 ) takes this route with a shared encoder, but retains an EMA target encoder and a predictor network.
This raises the question of how many of these components are necessary . LeJEPA ( Balestriero & LeCun, 2025 ) showed for single-modality vision that a symmetric view-invariance loss plus SIGReg, a regularizer that drives embeddings toward an isotropic Gaussian, trains stably with no teacher, predictor, stop-gradient, or negatives. However, whether the same holds for audio and video is unclear. When every view contains both modalities, the encoder can minimise the invariance loss using only the dominant modality and largely ignore the other. Learning a cross-modal representation therefore depends on views that separate the modalities, such that audio-only and video-only views of the same clip are mapped to a common embedding.
blocks.zh:
现有的视听SSL方法通过几种不同的培训目标将音频和视频结合起来. AV-MAE(Georgescu等人,2023年),CAV-MAE(Gong等人,2023年),MAViL(Huang等人,2023年),以及CAV-MAE Sync(Araujo等人,2025年)通过解码器重建蒙面光谱和像素补丁,大多数在跨模式负数上添加InfoNCE术语,MAViL增加了第二个自我训练阶段. 或者,在潜在空间中预测的重点是学习表达方式,避免重建低级输入细节(Asran等人,2023年;Bardes等人,2024年)。 MJEPA (Teotia et al., 2026) 使用共享编码器走这条路线,但保留了EMA目标编码器和预测器网络.
这就提出了其中有多少组成部分是必要的问题。 LeJEPA(Balestriero & LeCun,2025年)为单一模式显示,对称的视差变化损失加上SIGREG, 常态化器驱动嵌入到异热带高斯人身上, 然而,对于音频和视频是否也存在同样的问题尚不清楚。 当每个视图都包含两种模式时,编码器只能使用主导模式来最小化不常损耗,基本上忽略了另一种模式. 因此,学习跨模式的表达方式取决于将模式区分开来的观点,例如将同一片段的仅音频和仅视频的视图绘制成共同嵌入式。

blocks.en: We introduce LeAVJEPA , a minimalist audio-visual JEPA that trains a single shared early-fusion Vision Transformer with only an invariance loss and SIGReg, treating paired audio and video as partial observations of the same event. The encoder maps each audio, video, or joint input to a sequence of tokens ( Fig. 1 ), where global views contain both modalities and modality dropout makes local views audio-only or video-only. The invariance loss pulls each local-view embedding toward the centre of the global views, requiring the encoder to infer the joint representation from either modality alone. The views determine which modalities the encoder observes, while the common centre defines the representation to be predicted. Cross-modal prediction thus emerges implicitly in latent space, without a teacher, predictor, decoder, or negatives.
blocks.zh: 我们介绍LeAVJEPA, 一个最小化的视听JEPA, 编码器将每个音频,视频或联合输入到一个符号序列(图1)中,其中全球视图既包含模式,也包含模式退出,使得本地视图只使用音频或视频。 变化性损失将每个地方观点都嵌入到全球观点的中心,要求编码器仅从其中一种模式推断出联合代表。 观点决定了编码器所观察到的模式,而共同中心则定义了要预测的表示. 因此,跨模式预测隐含在潜在的空间中,没有老师、预测者、解码器或负数。

blocks.en: On VGGSound and AudioSet, LeAVJEPA reaches 61.1% accuracy after fine-tuning and 36.0 mAP on AudioSet-20K with a frozen attentive probe, and its embeddings support audio ↔ \leftrightarrow video retrieval without retrieval-specific training. These results show that the shared-encoder approach is effective, although the strongest published methods still perform better. A controlled ablation identifies modality-specific views as central to representation quality. Masked local views nearly halve linear-probe accuracy, and joint local views reduce it to the level of pretraining on audio alone.
blocks.zh: 在VGGSound和AudioSet上,LeAVJEPA在微调后达到61.1%的精度,在AudioSet-20K上用冷冻的细心探测器达到36.0 mAP,其嵌入支持音频QQ\\左侧右侧视频检索而无需进行特定检索训练. 这些结果表明,共享编码方法是有效的,尽管最强的公布方法仍然表现更好. 受控退约确定特定模式的意见是代表质量的核心。 遮蔽的局部观点几乎将线性概率的准确度减半,而局部的联合观点则将其降低到仅对音频进行预训的水平.

blocks.en: Together, these findings support three contributions: • A minimalist audio-visual JEPA that trains a single shared early-fusion encoder with a symmetric invariance loss and SIGReg, with no reconstruction decoder, EMA teacher, predictor, contrastive negatives, or multi-stage schedule ( Table 1 ). • Modality dropout for partial-view learning , which makes cross-modal prediction an implicit property of the invariance objective rather than a separate loss or network ( Sec. 3.1 ). • An empirical study that first isolates the contribution of view construction through a controlled ablation, showing that modality-specific local views substantially outperform masked, joint, audio-only, and no-local-view alternatives ( Sec. 4.1 ), and then evaluates frozen transfer, zero-shot retrieval, and end-to-end fine-tuning with ViT-B and ViT-L backbones on VGGSound and AudioSet-2M ( Sec. 4 ).
blocks.zh: 这些调查结果加在一起支持了三项贡献: 一个最小的视听JEPA,它训练一个共享的早期融合编码器,其变异损失对称,SIGREG,没有重建解码器,EMA教师,预测器,对比负数,或多阶段时间表(表1) ——部分视图学习模式的退出,使跨模式预测成为变异目标的隐含属性,而不是单独的损失或网络(第3.1节)。 一项经验性研究,该研究首先通过有控制的割裂来隔离视图构建的贡献,显示模式特定的局部视图在遮掩,联合,只听,和无局部视图的替代物上明显超标(第4.1节),然后在VGGSound和AudioSet-2M(第4节)上评价冷冻转移,零镜头检索,并与ViT-B和ViT-L主干线进行端到端的微调.

blocks.zh: 一个最小化的视听JEPA,它训练一个单一的共享的早期融合编码器,具有对称的失常和SIGREG,没有重建解码器,EMA教师,预测器,对比性底片,或者多阶段时间表(表1).

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Early work used audio-visual correspondence ( Arandjelović & Zisserman, 2017 ) and temporal synchrony ( Korbar et al., 2018 ) as pretext tasks; AVID-CMA ( Morgado et al., 2021 ) , XDC ( Alwassel et al., 2020 ) , and VATT ( Akbari et al., 2021 ) then aligned the two modalities with InfoNCE ( van den Oord et al., 2018 ) or clustering objectives. A second line masks and reconstructs raw inputs: AV-MAE ( Georgescu et al., 2023 ) , CAV-MAE ( Gong et al., 2023 ) , MAViL ( Huang et al., 2023 ) , and CAV-MAE Sync ( Araujo et al., 2025 ) extend MAE ( He et al., 2022 ) to paired audio and video, in most cases with an added contrastive term. These approaches establish reconstruction and explicit alignment as effective learning signals. We study how far a common-centre objective can go when modality dropout supplies the partial observations.
blocks.zh: 早期作品使用视听通信(Arandjelović & Zisserman, 2017)和时间同步(Korbar等人, 2018年)作为借口任务; AVID-CMA(Morgado等人, 2021年), XDC (Alwassel等人,2020年),以及VATT(Akbari等人,2021年)之后将两种模式与InfoNCE(van den Oord等人,2018年)或集群目标对齐. 第二行口罩并重建原始输入:AV-MAE(Georgescu等人,2023年),CAV-MAE(Gong等人,2023年),MAViL(Huang等人,2023年),CAV-MAE Sync(Araujo等人,2025年)将MAE(He等人,2022年)扩展成对音频和视频,在大多数情况下都增加了一个对比词. 这些办法将重建和明确调整作为有效的学习信号。 我们研究当模式辍学提供部分观察结果时,共同中心目标可走多远。

blocks.en: Single-modality methods establish how to turn sound and video into useful representations. wav2vec 2.0 ( Baevski et al., 2020 ) and HuBERT ( Hsu et al., 2021 ) learn from waveforms; AST ( Gong et al., 2021 ) , SSAST ( Gong et al., 2022 ) , AudioMAE ( Huang et al., 2022 ) , and BEATs ( Chen et al., 2023 ) operate on spectrograms. ViViT ( Arnab et al., 2021 ) and TimeSformer ( Bertasius et al., 2021 ) develop transformer architectures for video. Our architecture uses modality-specific tokenization to bring both streams into one transformer.
blocks.zh: 单一模式方法确定如何将声音和视频转化为有用的表述。 wav2vec 2.0(Baevski等人,2020年)和HuBERT(Hsu等人,2021年)从波形学;AST(Gong等人,2021年),SSAST(Gong等人,2022年),AudioMAE(Huang等人,2022年),BeATs(Chen等人,2023年)在光谱学上运行. ViViT(Anab等人,2021年)和TimeSformer(Bertasius等人,2021年)为视频开发变压器架构. 我们的建筑采用了特定模式的标志化,将两条流都引入一个变压器.

blocks.en: BYOL ( Grill et al., 2020 ) and SimSiam ( Chen & He, 2021 ) match embeddings across views without negatives, and DINO ( Caron et al., 2021 ) and DINOv2 ( Oquab et al., 2024 ) add multi-crop self-distillation. A complementary line replaces the asymmetric teacher with an explicit distribution-level regularizer: VICReg ( Bardes et al., 2022 ) and Barlow Twins ( Žbontar et al., 2021 ) constrain the embedding covariance and W-MSE ( Ermolov et al., 2021 ) whitens it. However, these methods constrain only the second-order statistics of the embedding distribution. LeAVJEPA instead inherits SIGReg ( Balestriero & LeCun, 2025 ) , which matches the full distribution to an isotropic Gaussian using a sliced characteristic-function test.
blocks.zh: BYOL(Grill等人,2020年)和SimSiam(Chen & He,2021年)在不带负数的情况下匹配了横跨视界的嵌入,DINO(Caron等人,2021年)和DINov2(Oquab等人,2024年)则加入了多作物自沉. 一条补充线用明确的分布级规范剂取代不对称教师:VICReg(Bardes等人,2022年)和Barlow Twins(Žbontar等人,2021年)约束嵌入共变,W-MSE(Ermolov等人,2021年)使其白化. 然而,这些方法只限制了嵌入式分布的二阶统计. LeAVJEPA转而继承了SIGREG(Balestriero & LeCun,2025年),它利用切片特征函数测试将完全分布匹配到异热带高斯人.

blocks.en: Table 1: Comparison of audio-visual SSL methods. LeAVJEPA is the only method that requires none of the listed components.
blocks.zh: 表1:视听SSL方法比较. LeAVJEPA是唯一不需要任何所列成分的方法.

blocks.en: The Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture ( LeCun, 2022 ) predicts the embedding of one view from another instead of reconstructing inputs. I-JEPA ( Assran et al., 2023 ) instantiates it with spatial masking on images; V-JEPA ( Bardes et al., 2024 ) and V-JEPA 2 ( Assran et al., 2025 ) extend it to video and world modelling; and LeJEPA ( Balestriero & LeCun, 2025 ) supplies the theoretical grounding through SIGReg. MJEPA ( Teotia et al., 2026 ) is the closest audio-visual JEPA: it shares encoder parameters across modalities but trains with an EMA target encoder and a predictor network, both of which LeAVJEPA removes.
blocks.zh: 联合Embedding Presidentive Architecture (LeCun, 2022) 预测从另一个角度嵌入一个视图而不是重建输入. I-JEPA(Asran等人, 2023年)在图像上用空间遮掩来即兴制作;V-JEPA(Bardes等人, 2024年)和V-JEPA 2(Asran等人, 2025年)将其扩展至视频和世界建模;LeJEPA(Balestriro & LeCun, 2025年)通过SIGreg提供理论基础. MJEPA(Teotia等人,2026年)是最接近的视听JEPA:它分享跨模式的编码器参数,但列车使用EMA目标编码器和预测器网络,LeAVJEPA均去除.

blocks.en: CLIP ( Radford et al., 2021 ) and ALIGN ( Jia et al., 2021 ) learn cross-modal similarity by contrasting matched and mismatched image–text pairs. AudioCLIP ( Guzhov et al., 2022 ) , ImageBind ( Girdhar et al., 2023 ) , and LanguageBind ( Zhu et al., 2024 ) extend shared embedding spaces to audio and further modalities. These approaches train explicit cross-modal alignment. In contrast, LeAVJEPA has no such objective: audio-only and video-only views are each pulled toward the same joint embedding, but are never compared directly or ranked against negatives. Retrieval therefore tests whether cross-modal correspondence emerges without being trained explicitly ( Sec. 4.3 ).
blocks.zh: CLIP(Radford等人,2021年)和ALIGN(Jia等人,2021年)通过对比匹配和不匹配的图像-文本对来学习跨模式相似性. 音频CLIP (Guzhov等人,2022年),ImageBind(Girdhar等人,2023年),和LanguageBind(Zhu等人,2024年)将共享嵌入空间扩展至音频和进一步模式. 这些办法要求明确采用交叉模式。 反之,LeAVJEPA并没有这样的目标:只有音频和视频的视图被拉向相同的联合嵌入,但从未直接或对照负数进行对比。 因此,检索检验是否出现没有经过明确培训的交叉式通信(第4.3节)。

blocks.en: SwAV ( Caron et al., 2020 ) introduced multi-crop training with few global and many local crops, a strategy inherited by DINO and LeJEPA. AV-HuBERT ( Shi et al., 2022 ) uses modality dropout for robustness to missing inputs. We bring these ideas together by making the missing modality define a partial view: sound alone and video alone must each approach a representation learned from their joint observation. The controlled ablation tests whether this change in view composition supplies a useful learning signal beyond ordinary cropping and masking.
blocks.zh: SWAV(Caron等人,2020年)推出多作物培训,全球和许多地方作物很少,这一策略由DINO和LeJEPA继承. AV-HuBERT(Shi等人,2022年)对缺失的投入采用退出模式。 我们把这些想法汇集在一起,使缺失的模式定义了部分观点:只有声音和视频,每一个方法都必须有一个从共同观察中吸取的体现。 受控的衰减测试了这种视图成分的变化是否提供了超出普通裁剪和遮盖的有用的学习信号.

blocks.en: 3 Methods
blocks.zh: 3个 方法

blocks.en: LeAVJEPA maps audio-only, video-only, and joint audio-visual inputs of the same clip to a common embedding. Each local view loses a modality and learns to match the joint audio-video centre. We first construct these views, then describe the shared encoder and the objective that brings their embeddings together while preventing collapse ( Fig. 1 ).
blocks.zh: LeAVJEPA将同一片段的音频、视频和联合视听投入映射到共同嵌入中。 每个本地视图都会失去一个模式,并学习匹配联合音频-视频中心. 我们首先构建这些观点,然后描述共同的编码器,以及将其嵌入在一起同时防止崩溃的目标(图1).

video-to-audio attention follows its harmonic and temporal structure.
Neither behaviour is explicitly supervised; both emerge from matching
single-modality views to a joint centre.
blocks.zh:
图 2:注意在没有本地化监督的情况下找到声音源. 音频到视频的注意力落在产生声音的物体上,以及

两种行为都没有受到明确监督;两者都来自匹配

blocks.en: 3.1 Constructing Joint and Partial Views
blocks.zh: 3.1 构建联合和部分意见

blocks.en: A joint view can use either sound or visual information to match another joint view. Removing one modality leaves the encoder with only the other, so an audio-only view must be matched from sound alone and a video-only view from appearance and motion alone. In both cases, the target is given by global views that retain both modalities.
blocks.zh: 一个联合视图可以使用声音或视觉信息来匹配另一个联合视图. 删除一种模式只留下另一种编码器,所以只用音频的视图必须单独从声音中匹配,只用视频的视图必须单独从外观和运动中匹配. 在这两种情况下,目标都由保留两种模式的全球观点提出。

blocks.en: We sample two 8-second temporal crops with random offsets from each 10-second clip. Both global views ( G = 2 G{=}2 ) contain audio and video, with a centre crop and random horizontal flip for video and a clean mel spectrogram for audio. After encoding and projection, we average their embeddings to form the joint centre 𝒛 ¯ \bar{{\bm{z}}} . Each clip has its own centre, connecting observations of that clip.
blocks.zh: 我们从每10秒的片段中抽取了两片8秒的时间性作物。 两种全局视图(G=2 GQQ2)都包含音频和视频,其中心裁剪和视频的随机水平翻转以及音频的清真 mel光谱. 在编码和投影后,我们平均它们的嵌入物形成联合中心 z \bar{{\bm{z}}} 。 每个片段都有自己的中心,连接了该片段的观察.

blocks.en: We also form two local views ( K = 2 K{=}2 ) from the temporal crops. Even-indexed local views retain only audio, with a clean spectrogram; odd-indexed views retain only video, with standard augmentations. We drop the absent modality’s tokens entirely, shortening the sequence. Here, “local” refers to a partial set of modalities rather than a shorter temporal extent. This extends LeJEPA’s spatial augmentations ( Balestriero & LeCun, 2025 ) to the modality axis, so that each local view is a partial observation of the clip restricted to a single modality.
blocks.zh: 我们还从时间作物中形成了两种地方观点(K=2K{=}2). 偶联索引的本地视图只保留音频,有干净的光谱;奇异索引视图只保留视频,有标准的增强. 我们完全放弃了没有模式的标志,缩短了顺序。 在此,“当地”是指一套部分方式,而不是较短的时间范围。 这把LeJEPA的空间增强(Balestriero & LeCun,2025年)延伸到模式轴,因此每个局部视图都是对片段的部分观察,仅限于一种模式.

blocks.en: The embeddings of both partial views are pulled toward the joint centre. Neither view has to reconstruct the missing modality, so the audio view does not predict visual motion and the video view does not predict the waveform. Each instead predicts an embedding computed from the joint observation, which encourages the encoder to retain information that audio and video share. Section 4.1 tests this by varying only the local views.
blocks.zh: 两个部分观点的嵌入点被拉向联合中心。 两个视图都不必重建缺失模式,因此音频视图不会预测视觉运动,视频视图也不会预测波形. 两者都预测通过联合观察计算出的嵌入,鼓励编码器保留音频和视频共享的信息. 第4.1节仅通过不同的地方观点来检验这一点。

blocks.en: 3.2 Encoding Joint and Partial Views with One Model
blocks.zh: 3.2 联合和部分意见与一个模式

blocks.en: We project audio and video to tokens of the transformer’s hidden dimension, so that a single transformer and projector process every view. Joint and partial views differ only in which tokens enter the sequence, and all are embedded in the same representation space.
blocks.zh: 我们将音频和视频投射到变压器隐藏维度的标志上,这样一个变压器和投影器就能处理每个视图。 共同观点和部分观点只在哪些符号进入序列上存在分歧,所有符号都嵌入在同一代表空间中.

blocks.en: We resample audio to 16 kHz and convert each 8-second crop into a mel spectrogram of shape × × 801 1\!\times\!128\!\times\!801 . A 2D convolution with kernel and stride ( 16 , 16 ) (16,16) produces × 50 = 400 8\!\times\!50=400 audio tokens. For video, a 3D convolution with kernel and stride ( 2 , 16 , 16 ) (2,16,16) maps 16 16 RGB frames at × 224 224\!\times\!224 resolution to × 14 2 = 1568 8\!\times\!14^{2}=1568 tubelet tokens. Factorized positional embeddings preserve frequency and time for audio, and spatial position and time for video. Learned modality-type embeddings identify which stream each token belongs to.
blocks.zh: 我们把音频重新做成16千赫, 并且将每8秒的收成转换成一个 ×× 801 1\!\ times\!128\!801的Mel光谱. 与内核和脚步(16,16)的二维进化(16,16)产生×50=400 8\!\times\! 50=400音响符号. 对于视频,一个带有内核和脚步(2,16,16)的3D演化(2,16)将16个RGB帧绘制在×224/224\!\times\!224解析度=14 2=1568 8\!\times\!14×2×1568 管状符号. 因素化位置嵌入保留了音频的频率和时间,以及视频的空间位置和时间. 学习模式类型的嵌入确定每个符号属于哪个流 。

blocks.en: We prepend a learnable [CLS] token and concatenate the available tokens. A joint view has the sequence [ CLS ; 𝒗 1 , … , 𝒗 1568 ; 𝒂 1 , … , 𝒂 400 ] , [\texttt{CLS};\,{\bm{v}}_{1},\ldots,{\bm{v}}_{1568};\,{\bm{a}}_{1},\ldots,{\bm{a}}_{400}], (1) while audio-only and video-only views contain 401 and 1569 tokens, respectively. Early fusion lets the transformer attend across modalities from its first layer when both are present. When one is absent, the same weights process the surviving tokens; no separate encoder or placeholder tokens for the missing modality are needed.
blocks.zh: 我们预留一个可以学习的 [CLS] 符号, 并召集可用的符号。 联合视图有顺序 [CLS; v 1,..., v 1568; a 1,..., a 400], [\textt{CLS}];\,\bm{v}}_{1},\ldots,\bm{v}}_{1568};\,\bm{a}}_{1},\ldots,\bm{a}}_{400}], (1)而只有音频和视频的视图分别包含401和1569个令牌. 早期的聚变使变压器在两种变压器都存在时,都能从第一层的不同方式参与. 当一个人缺席时,同样的权重会处理幸存的代币;不需要为缺失模式单独设置编码器或占位符代币.

blocks.en: For ViT-B ( Dosovitskiy et al., 2021 ) , we use 12 layers, a hidden dimension of 768, and 12 attention heads; for ViT-L, we use 24 layers, a hidden dimension of 1024, and 16 attention heads. A shared three-layer MLP projects the [CLS] output through d → → → 128 d\!\to\!2048\!\to\!2048\!\to\!128 dimensions, where d d is the hidden dimension, with BatchNorm and GELU. This projector maps every view into the space where we compute the loss; it is not a separate cross-modal predictor. Section A.1 and Fig. A1 give the full architecture.
blocks.zh: 对于Vit-B(Dosovitskiy等人,2021年),我们使用12层,隐藏的维度为768,还有12个注意力头;对于Vit-L,我们使用24层,隐藏的维度为1024,还有16个注意力头. 一个共享的三层 MLP通过 d → → 128 d\!to\!2048\!to\!2048\!\=!128维度,其中dd是隐藏的维度,有BatchNorm和GELU. 这个投影仪将每个视图映射到我们计算损失的空间;它不是一个单独的跨模式预测器. A.1节和图A1给出了完整的架构.

blocks.en: Figure 3: Semantic classes cluster, and a clip’s views stay close. t-SNE of [CLS] embeddings, where each clip contributes an audio-only ( ), a video-only ( ), and a joint ( ) point. Within each cluster, the three shapes mix: audio-only and video-only views of a class land together even though they share no input. The zoom shows the guitar sample, whose joint embedding ( z g z_{g} ) lies between its audio ( z ^ a \hat{z}_{a} ) and video ( z ^ v \hat{z}_{v} ) embeddings, as the invariance loss (bottom) encourages.
blocks.zh: 图3:语义类类群,一个片段的观点保持接近. [CLS]嵌入式的 t-SNE,其中每段片段贡献一个只有音频的( ),一个只有视频的( ),和一个联合的( )点. 在每组内,三个形状混合了:一个阶级土地的只有音频和只有视频的视图,尽管它们没有共享输入. 缩放显示吉他样本,其联合嵌入(z g z_{g})位于其音频(z ^ a\hat{z}_{a})和视频(z ^ v\hat{z}_{v})嵌入,正如不常丢失(下方)鼓励的那样.

blocks.en: 3.3 Matching Views without Collapse
blocks.zh: 3.3 不折叠匹配视图

blocks.en: We want observations of the same clip to agree while retaining differences between clips. However, matching views alone would allow the encoder to return the same vector for every input. The LeJEPA objective ( Balestriero & LeCun, 2025 ) addresses both requirements by combining an invariance loss with distributional regularization. Let 𝒛 i = p ϕ ​ ( f θ ​ ( x i ) ) ∈ ℝ d z {\bm{z}}_{i}=p_{\phi}(f_{\theta}(x_{i}))\in\mathbb{R}^{d_{z}} denote a projected view embedding and 𝒛 ¯ = 1 G ​ ∑ g = 1 G 𝒛 g \bar{{\bm{z}}}=\frac{1}{G}\sum_{g=1}^{G}{\bm{z}}_{g} the mean of the global embeddings for the same clip. We minimize ℒ = ( 1 − λ ) ​ 1 G + K ​ ∑ i = 1 G + K ‖ 𝒛 ¯ − 𝒛 i ‖ 2 ⏟ invariance + λ ​ SIGReg ​ ( { 𝒛 i } ) ⏟ regularization , \mathcal{L}=(1-\lambda)\,\underbrace{\frac{1}{G+K}\sum_{i=1}^{G+K}\|\bar{{\bm{z}}}-{\bm{z}}_{i}\|^{2}}_{\text{invariance}}\;+\;\lambda\,\underbrace{\vphantom{\sum_{i=1}^{G+K}}\text{SIGReg}(\{{\bm{z}}_{i}\})}_{\text{regularization}}, (2) where λ \lambda balances agreement and distributional regularization. The invariance term is written for one clip and averaged over the minibatch; SIGReg regularizes embeddings across clips.

LeJEPA的目标(Balestriero & LeCun,2025年)通过将无变化损失与分配正规化相结合来解决这两项要求。 让 z i = p φ (f θ (x i)) ∈ {\fn方正黑体简体\fs18\b1\bord1\shad1\3cH2F2F2F}(f_{\theta}(x_{i}))\ in\mathbb{R}^{d_{z}} 表示预测视图嵌入,z = 1 G = 1 G z g\ bar\ bm{ z\ frac{ 1}\ \\ sum\ g= 1\\ \ \ bm{ \ \ \ \ \ g} 同一片段的全球嵌入的平均值。 最小化 L = (1 - + ) 1 G + K = i = 1 G + K ̄ ̄ − i ‖ 2 ⏟ invariation + λ Sigreg ({ z i }). 正规化 ,\ mathcal{L}=(1-\lambda)\,\underbrace\frac{1}G+K+}\sum{i=1}G+K+}\|\bar{{\bm{z}}}-{\bm{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{};\lambda\,\underbrace\vphantom}{summ_{i=1}G+K+}}\text{{{{{{{{{{{{}}正规化 ,(2)\lambda平衡协议和分配规范。 惯用词为1个片段所写,平均在小片段上;SIGREG将嵌入跨片段的规范化.

blocks.en: The invariance term draws all views toward their clip’s centre, and gradients also flow through the global embeddings that form it. The centre is therefore learned alongside the partial views, rather than being fixed or supplied by a second encoder. All views update the shared encoder and projector through the same loss, without a stop-gradient, EMA teacher, or cross-modal predictor. The centre can consequently adapt to information that the partial observations can express.
blocks.zh: 而梯度也通过形成它的全球嵌入物流动。 因此,中心与部分观点一起学习,而不是由第二个编码器固定或提供。 所有视图都通过同样的损失更新共享编码器和投影仪,没有停止升级器,EMA老师,或跨模式预测器. 因此,中心可以适应部分观测能够表达的信息。

blocks.en: SIGReg ( Sketched Isotropic Gaussian Regularization ) supplies the pressure against collapse by matching the distribution of embeddings across clips to an isotropic Gaussian. It projects embeddings onto M M random unit directions and compares each projection’s empirical characteristic function with the Gaussian target through the Epps–Pulley test. Resampling directions at each step constrains the distribution across different slices. For a fixed number of directions and evaluation points, the computation is linear in batch size and can aggregate the characteristic-function statistics across devices.
blocks.zh: SIGREG(Sketched Isotropic Gaussian Professionalization )通过将嵌入式的分布在片段之间与异质的Gaussian相匹配来提供防崩溃的压力. 它通过Epps-Pulley测试,将每个投影的经验特征功能与高斯目标进行比较。 每个步骤的复标方向会限制不同片段的分布. 对于固定数量的方向和评价点,计算以批量大小为线性,可以汇总跨设备的特征函数统计.

blocks.en: LeJEPA motivates the Gaussian target through its analysis of downstream probes: anisotropic covariance can amplify estimation error for linear probes, while an isotropic Gaussian minimizes integrated squared bias for the nonlinear probes considered in that analysis. These results motivate our regularizer under LeJEPA’s assumptions; they do not guarantee optimal performance on arbitrary audio-visual tasks. The two terms act at different levels: invariance brings a clip’s views together, while SIGReg preserves spread across clips. Their separate ablations in Sec. 4.1 test whether both are needed.
blocks.zh: LeJEPA通过分析下游探测器来激励高斯人的目标:异位共变能扩大线性探测器的估计误差,而异位高斯人则将该分析中考虑的非线性探测器的综合平方偏差最小化. 这些结果激励了我们在LeJEPA的假设下的常态化者;它们不能保证在任意的视听任务上取得最佳业绩. 这两个术语在不同层面上起作用:不常将一个剪辑的观点汇集在一起,而SIGREG则保留了横跨剪辑的内容. 它们在第4.1节中分别烧伤,检验是否需要两者。

blocks.en: No loss term compares audio-only and video-only embeddings directly. Both are instead pulled toward the same joint centre, and since ‖ 𝒛 a − 𝒛 v ‖ ≤ ‖ 𝒛 a − 𝒛 ¯ ‖ + ‖ 𝒛 ¯ − 𝒛 v ‖ \|{\bm{z}}_{a}-{\bm{z}}_{v}\|\leq\|{\bm{z}}_{a}-\bar{{\bm{z}}}\|+\|\bar{{\bm{z}}}-{\bm{z}}_{v}\| , this also brings them close to each other. Retrieval additionally requires each embedding to lie closer to its partner than to other clips. SIGReg encourages this by spreading embeddings across clips, but the objective does not enforce it directly. Figure 3 illustrates the resulting neighbourhoods, and Sec. 4.3 evaluates retrieval quantitatively.
blocks.zh: 无损失名词直接比较音频和视频专用嵌入. 两人却被拉到同一个联合中心, 由于 ‖ z z ≤ ‖ ‖, 检索额外要求每个嵌入物都比其他片段更接近其伙伴. SIGREG通过将嵌入到剪辑之间来鼓励这一点,但目标并没有直接执行. 图3说明了由此产生的街区,第4.3节对检索进行了定量评估。

blocks.en: 3.4 Monitoring the Representation
blocks.zh: 3.4 监测代表机构

blocks.en: We evaluate AudioSet-pretrained backbones with a linear probe on the [CLS] token and an attentive probe that pools patch tokens through one cross-attention query ( Bardes et al., 2024 ; Teotia et al., 2026 ) . Since no probes are attached during pretraining, both are trained afterwards, either on the frozen backbone following standard audio-visual evaluation ( Gong et al., 2023 ; Araujo et al., 2025 ) or jointly with the backbone during end-to-end fine-tuning. Appendix B gives the training configurations.
blocks.zh: 我们评价AudioSet预先训练的骨干,在[CLS]标志上有一个线性探测器,并有一个注意的探测器,通过一个交叉注意的查询来集合补丁信号(Bardes等人,2024年;Teotia等人,2026年)。 由于在前期训练期间没有附加探测器,因此在后期,无论是在标准视听评价后在冷冻骨干上(Gong等人,2023年;Araujo等人,2025年),还是在端到端微调期间与骨干共同培训。 附 录 B给出了训练配置.

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4 实验

blocks.en: The evaluation first tests whether modality dropout is responsible for the improvement in representation quality ( Sec. 4.1 ). We then examine whether the learned features remain useful under frozen transfer ( Sec. 4.2 ), align audio and video well enough for cross-modal retrieval ( Sec. 4.3 ), and improve further with end-to-end fine-tuning ( Sec. 4.4 ).
blocks.zh: 评价首先检验模式辍学是否对提高代表质量负有责任(第4.1节)。 然后,我们审查在冻结转让(第4.2节)下所学到的特征是否仍然有用,对音频和视频进行适当调整,以便进行跨模式检索(第4.3节),并进一步改进端到端的微调(第4.4节)。

blocks.en: AudioSet ( Gemmeke et al., 2017 ) provides approximately two million clips with 527 multi-label sound classes; VGGSound ( Chen et al., 2020 ) provides approximately 184k training clips across 309 event classes. The ablations pretrain a ViT-B on VGGSound under a fixed short budget. The transfer, retrieval, and fine-tuning experiments use a ViT-B and a ViT-L pretrained on AudioSet-2M with two global and two modality-specific local views and λ = 0.05 \lambda{=}0.05 . Appendix B lists the full training configurations. All results are from single runs, except where noted.
blocks.zh: AudioSet(Gemmeke et al.,2017年)提供约200万个剪辑,设有527个多标签音效班;VGGSoud(Chen et al.,2020年)提供约184k个跨309个活动班的培训剪辑. 在固定的短期预算下,在VGGSound上预装一个VIT-B。 转移、检索和微调实验使用AudioSet-2M上的ViT-B和ViT-L预训,具有两个全局和两种模式特有的本地视图,并且QQ=0.05\lambda+0.05。 B列出了完整的训练配置. 所有结果均来自单次运行,但注意到的地方除外。

blocks.en: Each table states whether it uses a frozen linear probe, a frozen attentive probe, or end-to-end fine-tuning. The probes measure information accessible in the pretrained features ( Sec. 3.4 ); fine-tuning additionally lets supervised gradients adapt the backbone.
blocks.zh: 每个表格都说明是使用冷冻的线性探测器,冷冻的细心探测器,还是端到端的微调. 探测器测量在预先训练过的特性中可获得的信息(第3.4节);再微调,使有监督的梯度能够调整骨干。

blocks.en: 4.1 Learning from Modality-Specific Partial Views
blocks.zh: 4.1 从模式----特定部分意见中学习

blocks.en: The first test separates the contribution of the views from that of the encoder and loss. If ordinary joint multi-crop views were sufficient, the model could learn useful audio-visual features without ever losing a modality. We pretrain a ViT-B on VGGSound with the same encoder, hyperparameters, and training budget, varying the local-view construction and including a no-local-view control. Figure 4 compares the resulting online probe test accuracies; Table A3 in Sec. C.3 lists the values with top-5 accuracy, loss values, and embedding statistics.
blocks.zh: 第一个测试将观点的贡献与编码器和损失区分开来. 如果普通的多作物联合观点足够,模型可以学习有用的视听特征,而不会失去一种模式。 我们用同样的编码器、超参数和培训预算,在VGGSoud上预装一个VIT-B, 改变局部视图的构造,包括无局部视图控制。 图4比较了由此产生的在线探测器试验强度;Sec表A3。 C.3列出了最高5级准确度、损失值和嵌入统计值。

blocks.en: Figure 4: Modality-specific views improve cross-modal learning in LeAVJEPA. Left: joint local views remain near the audio-only baselines (dashed lines). Random modality dropout improves probe accuracy, and making every local view audio-only or video-only yields the largest gain. Right: either loss term alone fails to learn useful features.
blocks.zh: 图4:针对不同模式的观点改善了LeAVJEPA的跨模式学习。 左侧:局部联合视图仍位于音频专用基线(dashed lines)附近. 随机模式的退出可以提高探针的准确性,使每个局部仅收音机或仅收视频的视图产生最大的收益. 右: 单是损失术语就无法学习有用的特征。

blocks.en: Joint local views remain close to the audio-only baseline, while global views alone perform no better ( Fig. 4 , left). The weak features do not arise from collapse: these variants achieve low invariance loss and near-unit embedding standard deviation ( Table A3 ). They instead reflect a limitation of the task, since when every view contains both modalities, the views can agree through one modality alone without the encoder relating it to the other. The results are consistent with this shortcut. Distributional regularity rules out collapse, but it does not show that the features combine information from audio and video.
blocks.zh: 当地的联合观点仍然接近于仅有音频的基线,而仅全球观点就没有什么更好的效果(图4,左)。 薄弱的特征并非由坍塌产生:这些变体实现低的内向损失和近单元嵌入标准偏差(表A3 ). 相反,它们反映了任务的局限性,因为当每一种观点都包含两种模式时,观点可以通过一种模式单独商定,而无需编码器将其与另一种模式联系起来。 结果与这个快捷键一致. 分布规律排除了崩溃,但并没有显示这些功能结合了音频和视频的信息.

blocks.en: When a local view contains only audio or only video, the encoder must match the joint centre from that modality alone. Random modality dropout improves both probes, and consistently making each local view audio-only or video-only yields the strongest features. The agreement between linear and attentive evaluation suggests that the benefit is not specific to one type of probe. Since these comparisons retain the same encoder, objective, and training budget, they identify view composition as a consequential design choice. Merely supplying both modalities does not confer the benefit obtained by learning from partial observations.
blocks.zh: 当一个局部视图只包含音频或仅包含视频时,编码器必须仅从该模式与联合中心匹配. 随机模式的退出可以改进两个探测器,并且始终使每个局部视图只收音机或只收视频,产生最强的功能. 线性评价和细心评价之间的一致表明,这种好处并非专门针对一种类型的探测。 由于这些比较保留了相同的编码器、目标和培训预算,因此它们将组成视为一种相应的设计选择。 仅仅提供两种方式并不能从部分观察中获取好处。

blocks.en: The loss ablations distinguish the roles of alignment and regularization ( Fig. 4 , right). Removing SIGReg ( λ = 0 \lambda{=}0 ) collapses the embedding and reduces classification toward chance. Removing invariance ( λ = 1 \lambda{=}1 ) preserves embedding spread but also fails to learn useful features. Neither agreement alone nor distributional regularity alone is sufficient under this training protocol. The full objective makes the modality-specific task learnable while avoiding its trivial solution. Additional comparisons find similar performance with separate encoders and limited sensitivity to the tested SIGReg weights and local-view counts ( Sec. C.3 ), suggesting that the gain does not depend on one architectural configuration or a narrowly selected hyperparameter value.
blocks.zh: 损失与调整和规范化的作用不同(图4,右)。 删除 SIGREG( QQ = 0\ lambda =0) 将嵌入式崩溃, 并降低分类 。 删除偏移( QQ = 1\ lambda% 1) 保留嵌入扩散, 但也未能学习有用的特性 。 根据这项培训议定书,单靠协议或分配规则是不够的。 完全目标使得特定方式的任务可以学习,同时避免其微不足道的解决方案. 额外的比较发现有类似的性能,有单独的编码器,对所测试的SIGREG加权数和局部视图计数(Sec. C.3 )的敏感度有限,说明收益不取决于一个建筑配置或狭义选择的超参数值.

blocks.en: 4.2 Frozen Transfer to AudioSet-20K and ESC-50
blocks.zh: 4.2 冻结转入AudioSet-20K和ESC-50

blocks.en: The ablation shows that modality dropout produces better features on the pretraining dataset. We next test whether those features transfer to other tasks with the encoder frozen, so that downstream labels can train a probe but cannot change the representation. Table 2 follows the frozen protocol of MJEPA ( Teotia et al., 2026 ) : an attentive probe on frozen AudioSet-pretrained features, evaluated on AudioSet-20K with audio-only (A), video-only (V), and audio-video (A-V) inputs, and on ESC-50 ( Piczak, 2015 ) . Baseline rows are the re-evaluations reported by MJEPA under the same protocol.

blocks.en: The frozen results show that both modalities contribute to the joint representation ( Table 2 ). Audio-only input is stronger than video-only input, yet combining them improves over audio alone for both model sizes. The larger backbone improves across audio, video, and joint evaluation, so its advantage is not restricted to a single input type. Transfer to ESC-50 further shows that features learned through the joint objective remain useful when only audio is available downstream.
blocks.zh: 冻结的结果表明,两种模式都有助于联合代表(表2)。 仅音频输入比仅视频输入更强大,然而将它们结合起来,对于两个模型大小来说都比音频要好. 更大的骨干在音频,视频,以及联合评价方面都有改善,因此其优势并不局限于单一输入类型. 转移到ESC-50进一步表明,当下游只有音频时,通过共同目标学到的特性仍然有用.

blocks.en: LeAVJEPA is competitive with several separate-encoder methods, although both model sizes remain below MJEPA. This supports the utility of the simpler objective, which reaches these results without MJEPA’s EMA teacher or predictor. The probe follows the evaluation protocol of MJEPA ( Teotia et al., 2026 ) , with a four-layer attentive probe trained for 40 epochs.
blocks.zh: LeAVJEPA在几种单独的编码器方法上具有竞争力,虽然两种型号尺寸仍然低于MJEPA. 这支持更简单目标的效用,因为没有司法部的EMA教师或预测员就能取得这些结果。 该探测器遵循了MJEPA的评价协议(Teotia等人,2026年),对40个纪元进行了四层的专注探测器训练.

blocks.en: 4.3 Cross-Modal Retrieval without a Contrastive Loss
blocks.zh: 4.3 跨潮流回收,不发生抵触损失

blocks.en: Classification can succeed without placing paired audio and video close enough for retrieval. We therefore test a more specific consequence of the common-centre objective: can a single-modality embedding identify its partner among other clips? We encode each clip twice, from its audio tokens alone and from its video tokens alone, and rank candidates by cosine similarity of the projected [CLS] features. We evaluate on the balanced AudioSet retrieval subset released with CAV-MAE ( Gong et al., 2023 ) , the pool also used by CAV-MAE Sync, EquiAV, and MJEPA.
blocks.zh: 分类可以成功,而无需将配对的音频和视频贴近到足以进行检索. 因此,我们测试共同中心目标的一个更具体的后果:嵌入的单一模式能否在其它短片中确定伙伴? 我们将每个片段编码两次,单从它的音响符号和单从它的视频符号,并以预测的[CLS]功能的余弦相似性对候选人进行排名. 我们评价CAV-MAE(Gong et al., 2023)发布的平衡AudioSet检索子集, CAV-MAE Sync、EquiAV和MJEPA也使用该子集。

blocks.en: Direct cosine retrieval is well above chance in both directions and improves consistently with the larger backbone ( Table 3 ). This shows that the model can identify a paired observation even when the query and candidate share no input modality. Nevertheless, the strongest methods trained with explicit cross-modal alignment remain ahead, indicating that matching a joint centre leaves room to improve cross-modal alignment.
blocks.zh: 直接的余弦检索在两个方向上都远远高于机会,并且与更大的主干网一致改进(表3)。 这表明,即使查询和候选者没有共享输入模式,模型也可以识别成对观察. 然而,经过培训的具有明确跨模式协调的最强方法仍然领先,表明联合中心的匹配为改进跨模式协调留有余地。

blocks.en: To test whether the frozen features support stronger retrieval with a learned head, we fit a contrastive (InfoNCE) head on 300 AudioSet training clips per class and select the best head on a held-out validation set. The head improves retrieval in both directions without updating the encoder.
blocks.zh: 为了测试冷冻特性是否支持使用有学问的头部进行更强的检索,我们在每个班级300个AudioSet训练片段上安装一个对比(InfonCE)头部,并在一个被搁置的验证集中选择最好的头部. 头部在不更新编码器的情况下改善双向检索.

blocks.en: We next fine-tune the entire encoder end to end, as in most published audio-visual SSL comparisons. Attentive pooling improves over the linear head for both model sizes ( Table 4 ), showing that the choice of classification head still matters after fine-tuning. However, the advantage of the larger backbone is less pronounced here than in frozen transfer or retrieval. This contrast shows why frozen and fine-tuned performance should be reported separately, since fine-tuning can compensate for differences in representation quality that frozen evaluation exposes.
blocks.zh: 我们接下来将对整个编码器进行精细调整,直到结束,就像大多数出版的视听SSL比较一样. 对两种模型大小(表4)的线性头部而言,Attentive集合有所改进,表明分类头的选择在微调后仍然很重要. 然而,更大的骨干在此处的优势不如在冻结转移或检索中那么明显. 这一对比表明,为什么应该单独报告冻结和微调的业绩,因为微调可以弥补冻结评价暴露的代表质量的差异。

blocks.en: The published baselines retain an advantage after fine-tuning, with a similar ordering on AudioSet-20K. Differences in initialization, objectives, and optimization prevent attributing this gap to any individual component. The shared-encoder approach therefore supports useful transfer, while matching the strongest fully adapted systems remains an open challenge.
blocks.zh: 公布的基线在微调后保留了优势,在AudioSet-20K上也有类似的订单. 在初始化、目标和优化方面的差异防止将这一差距归咎于任何单个组成部分。 因此,共享编码方法支持有用的转让,同时匹配最强的、经过充分调整的系统仍然是一个公开的挑战。

blocks.en: 5 Discussion and Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 讨论和结论

blocks.en: LeAVJEPA shows that the construction of partial views is central to learning useful audio-visual representations. Treating sound and vision as incomplete observations of the same event allows a shared encoder to learn cross-modal correspondence through a symmetric objective. This extends the role of view construction in self-supervised learning, since withholding a modality determines which input the encoder must use to predict a representation learned from both modalities. Agreement between views is informative only insofar as the views define a useful learning task. Modality-specific observations substantially improve the learned features under the same encoder and loss, demonstrating that the information retained in each view deserves explicit consideration when designing multimodal objectives. The contribution of LeAVJEPA is to establish that useful alignment and transfer can already emerge without a dedicated cross-modal predictor, reconstruction decoder, or teacher network. More broadly, our results show that a single encoder, a symmetric objective, and views that each contain only one modality are enough to learn strong cross-modal representations, offering a simple, scalable foundation for future multimodal models.
blocks.zh: LeAVJEPA显示,构筑部分观点对于学习有用的视听表现至关重要. 将声音和视觉视为对同一事件的不完整观测,使得共享编码器能够通过对称的目标学习跨模式的对应. 这扩展了视图构建在自我监督学习中的作用,因为预留一种模式决定了编码器必须使用何种输入来预测从两种模式中汲取的表示. 只有在意见确定了有益的学习任务时,意见之间的一致才具有信息性。 针对特定模式的观察大大改进了在同一编码器和损失下学到的特征,表明在设计多式联运目标时,应明确考虑每种观点中保留的信息。 LeAVJEPA的贡献是确定,如果没有专用的跨模式预测器、重建解码器或教师网络,就可能出现有用的对齐和转让。 更广泛地说,我们的结果表明,一个单一编码器、一个对称的目标,以及认为每种模式只包含一种模式的观点,足以学习强有力的跨模式表述,为未来的多式联运模式提供了一个简单、可扩展的基础。

blocks.en: Our evaluation relies mainly on sound-centric benchmarks, leaving the encoder’s broader visual capabilities unresolved. Published baselines also use different training protocols, so performance gaps are hard to attribute. Moreover, matching partial observations assumes that they contain sufficient shared information. Off-screen sounds and unrelated visual activity offer relevant tests of when that assumption no longer holds. A natural next step is to extend modality dropout beyond audio and video, for example to text or depth, and to evaluate on video-centric tasks. With the method reduced to one encoder and two loss terms, another is to make it cheaper to train, for example with fewer views, tokens, or steps.
blocks.zh: 我们的评价主要依靠以声音为中心的基准,使编码器更广泛的视觉能力得不到解决。 公布的基线也使用不同的训练协议,因此性能差距很难归属. 此外,与部分观察相匹配的假设是,它们包含足够的共享信息。 屏幕外的声音和无关的视觉活动为这种假设不再存在提供了相关测试。 下一个自然步骤是将模式退出范围扩大到音频和视频之外,例如扩大到文本或深度,并对以视频为中心的任务进行评价。 随着这个方法减少到一个编码器和两个损失条款,另一个是让训练更便宜,例如用更少的视图,符号,或步骤.

blocks.en: A.2 Linear and Attentive Probes
blocks.zh: A.2 线性及辅助性探测器

blocks.en: The linear probe applies LayerNorm and a linear classifier to the [CLS] token. The attentive probe instead pools encoder patch tokens through cross-attention. Concretely, the attentive probe maintains a single learnable query that attends to the full sequence of encoder patch tokens (audio and video, excluding [CLS] ) through a multi-head cross-attention layer ( d = 768 d{=}768 , 12 heads), followed by LayerNorm and a linear classifier that produces the class logits. Unlike the linear probe, which is forced to summarize the sequence through the [CLS] token alone, the attentive probe adaptively aggregates the most informative audio and video patches per sample, providing a more expressive probe of the frozen backbone ( Bardes et al., 2024 ; Teotia et al., 2026 ) .

blocks.en: C.2.1 Semantic Structure of the Embedding Space

blocks.en:

coarse semantic families (instruments, animals, vehicles, water/weather, human
voice, and sports), take the [CLS] embedding of each clip from the
fine-tuned LeAVJEPA ViT-B backbone,
and project the L2-normalised embeddings to two dimensions with t-SNE; points
are coloured by family.
Clips organise into compact, well-separated clusters that respect the family
grouping: each family occupies coherent regions of the projected space, and the

blocks.en: C.2.2 Feature PCA of Video Patch Tokens

blocks.en:
Fig. A8 visualises the video patch-token features of the fine-tuned
LeAVJEPA ViT-B encoder in the style of DINO/DINOv2 feature PCA.
For each instrument class we fit a single PCA jointly over the pooled
last-layer video patch tokens of four VGGSound clips, map the top three
principal components to RGB, and overlay the result on the video frames (rows
are clips, columns are frames; audio tokens are left uncoloured); because the
basis is shared across the four clips, a given colour denotes the same direction
in feature space. The sounding object (the piano keyboard, the body and neck of
the bass guitar) then takes a consistent colour across clips and
frames, clearly separated from the player and the background, indicating that
the encoder represents the visually salient sound source as a coherent,
instance-corresponding region of feature space, even though it is trained only
with clip-level objectives and never receives pixel- or region-level
supervision, providing a qualitative view of spatial feature structure; the audio-conditioning control is discussed in the main text.

blocks.en: C.4.3 Removing modality dropout and masking
blocks.zh: C.4.3 消除模式的退出和掩饰

blocks.en:
Fig. A14 disables modality dropout, tube masking,
and frequency/time masking ( p drop = 0 p_{\mathrm{drop}}{=}0 , r vid = 0 r_{\mathrm{vid}}{=}0 , r aud = 0 r_{\mathrm{aud}}{=}0 ).
Local views then differ from the global views only through random
resized crops and horizontal flips, while always retaining both
modalities.
The invariance loss drops one to two orders of magnitude below the
baseline trajectory because the alignment task is trivialised: there is
no partial-view perturbation forcing the model to predict the missing
modality from the surviving one.
SIGReg behaves similarly to the baseline, so the embedding distribution
is still well shaped, but the LeJEPA loss as a whole loses its
information bottleneck.
This suggests that removing these partial-view perturbations makes alignment easier; the single-factor modality-dropout controls appear in Sec. 4.1 .
